posts.title: New Album: Gone Dark
posts.description: I worked on a new album this past year as a follow-up to last year’s Covers. I finished it early September, submitted it for distribution, and then… nothing. It sat quietly in “approval” hell. But Gone Dark came out Monday which just so happened to be a very big day for a very different reason. […]
